entries.34a39b1e1abcd883: As a specialist manufacturer producing MDF consistently from wood raw materials, the company concentrates production at its head office plant in Kishiwada. It emphasizes its characteristics as a structural material, such as high load-bearing capacity and moisture- and condensation-proofing properties, and pursues added value as an environmentally conscious product.

entries.8c440871d0fa805a: The business is closely tied to the housing market, which is affected by the number of new housing starts, and in the current fiscal year housing starts were weak due to lower willingness to purchase housing and longer building confirmation application processes.
entries.91354d020a5f6652: A wood board manufacturer that produces the MDF (medium-density fiberboard) "Starwood," made from raw materials such as wood chips, and sells it for housing construction materials.
entries.a613cef0517833ae: As key measures under the medium-term management plan “REBUILD & CREATE VALUE 2028,” launched in April 2026, the company is expanding sales of structural MDF, switching to OEM production through stronger collaboration with overseas MDF plants, and mass-producing and selling the recycled building material PANECO® board M, whose main raw material is fiber waste. In addition to the housing building materials market, it intends to pursue non-residential fields.

Its main products are “Starwood” and “Starwood TFB,” which are used for housing building materials, flooring substrates, structural materials and others. It also sells imported products.

entries.ccee12ae62d7950b: Net sales for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥10,267 million, a slight increase from the previous year. Starwood rose above the previous year due to expanded sales for structural applications, among other factors, while Starwood TFB and imported products fell below the previous year due to lower sales volumes. Price revisions and production cost reductions contributed to a certain improvement in profitability, but were not enough to absorb increases in raw material prices and expenses.
